title: ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据
missingSignals: 描述评分指标或评测协议

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present ICLWorld, an online benchmark that evaluates the ICL of agents from digital to physical worlds, covering computer use and robot use, together with UIverse, a unified harness that turns every environment into a user interface.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We build 30 environments, record 630 demonstration videos (10+ hours), and design 160 tasks with customized, often counter-intuitive rules that cannot be satisfied without learning from the context.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across six frontier models, the strongest agents, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, succeed on 82% and 76% of computer-use runs but only 27% and 26% of robot-use runs, and a no-rule control reduces success to at most 8%.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We build 30 environments, record 630 demonstration videos (10+ hours), and design 160 tasks with customized, often counter-intuitive rules that cannot be satisfied without learning from the context.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: The same frontier agents now operate both computers and robots, yet their ICL remains insufficiently assessed: existing benchmarks are largely offline, rely on text or static images, and risk training-data contamination, while robot evaluations are limited to method-level ablations.
